title: Simple Past block-world directions
brief: A premium original block-world practice card for students: ten verbs per stage, retry mistakes until mastered, avatar movement and audible feedback.

artboards.title: Block path
artboards.tradeoff: Visible avatar, cave gear and dragon milestone make progress tangible; requires a wider world scene

artboards.title: Inventory
artboards.tradeoff: Ten-slot mastery is explicit; less sense of movement

artboards.title: Portal
artboards.tradeoff: Striking level transition; less granular per-answer progress
